text.en: The first modern World Series was played in 1903 between Boston and Pittsburgh.
text.es: La primera Serie Mundial moderna se disputó en 1903 entre Boston y Pittsburgh.

text.en: The first modern World Series was played in 1903 between Boston and Pittsburgh.
text.es: La primera Serie Mundial moderna se disputó en 1903 entre Boston y Pittsburgh.

text.en: Through 2025, American League teams won 68 of the 121 World Series played.
text.es: Hasta 2025, los equipos de la Liga Americana ganaron 68 de las 121 Series Mundiales.

text.en: From 2003 to 2016, World Series home-field advantage was given to the All-Star Game winner's league.
text.es: Entre 2003 y 2016, la localía de la Serie Mundial se otorgó a la liga ganadora del All-Star Game.
